subject: reasoning
question: A is the father of B. B is the brother of C. C is the sister of D. D is the wife of E. F is the mother of E. G is the husband of F. How is E related to A ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) A is the father of B.

2) B is the brother of C.

3) C is the sister of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf822574a6cf358f193811a952dbc6a5ce367111c01fa23ce2b01827d250ad5c.png] 

4) D is the wife of E.

5) F is the mother of E.

6) G is the husband of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/557150fc4137c1b56d67cd59d1dd81a201f4a9ee0e71a5140abc457cac5fb0ab.png] 

Thus, E is A's son-in-law or daughter's husband.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
